verdict.rationale: Entra ID provides genuine event-driven automation: Lifecycle Workflows run automatically as users move through joiner/mover/leaver events, Conditional Access triggers actions (like MFA) based on sign-in conditions, and SCIM/provisioning triggers automatic account actions across SaaS apps. These are rule-based, trigger-on-event systems usable via admin console or Graph API. Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-agent-specific rule authoring (e.g., natural-language rule definition), no independent/hands-on corroboration of workflow depth or reliability, and community commentary raises friction/security concerns around related auth automation (e.g., FIDO downgrade attack) that add caveats though don't directly contradict the rules-engine capability itself.
